firstMismatch.sourceBehavior: Carried eggs hatch at1328 and1376 through timeout.c hatch_egg1017-1170. First mismatch1452 is Woodland-elf armed attack against baby red dragon; mhitm.c mattackm AT_WEAP393-435 selects weapon then hitmm. Direct official overlay diagnostic confirms UnsupportedTurnBoundaryError armed monster attacking another monster.
firstMismatch.caller: timeout.c:hatch_egg -> tamedog -> later monmove.c monster combat -> mhitm.c:mattackm AT_WEAP -> hitmm

overlapCrosswalk.scope: Unresolved admitted cases, earlier submitted unadmitted Prep immutable packets, and within v50; resolved archive retained as regression inputs.
overlapCrosswalk.causalDistinction: Carried wished three-egg stack hatches several dragons and reschedules siblings; own spe1 floor egg follows lay_an_egg and floor messaging. The failing elf weapon attack is distinct from unarmed blacklight explosion and hero demon attacks.

cases.title: v50-camera-cursed-flash-action-attempt1
cases.mission: Camera cursed backfire flashes its user and applies blindness; applying a camera does not release the trapped demon (that belongs to breakage).
cases.sourceTrace: apply.c:use_camera -> zap.c:zapyourself: Cursed camera consumes a charge, then rn2(2)==0 calls zapyourself(TRUE) even when an outward direction was entered.

closestSavedCoverage.comment: Blocked B38 attempt for the active end.c:fuzzer_savelife -> peffects(POT_WATER) entry. This source-directed recipe reaches the debug fuzzer after removing the newt and attempting to eat a human werewolf corpse, then answering its confirmation. The corpse was not fully consumed: C printed `You stop eating the werewolf corpse.` and status changed to Satiated at step 48, so eat.c:done_eating/cpostfx did not establish lycanthropy. C then produced 12 deaths reaching fuzzer_savelife(end.c:959); its outer rn2(10) results were 2, 7, 6, 7, 4, 6, 5, 7, 4, 1, 9, and 7, so the source's temporary-remedy block was never entered and no peffects(POT_WATER) call occurred. JavaScript end.js:fuzzer_savelife also still names potion.c:peffects as unported at this caller. The C output is retained cache-only under .cache/B38-attempts; this recipe and attempt are not matching runtime evidence.

overlapCrosswalk.causalDistinction: This C observation exercises polyself.c:dospit -> dothrow.c:throwit under Level7 Wizard as cobra. Self-directed spit creates owned blinding venom and throws it with zero direction.. Unresolved v47 cases concern energy-vortex melee drain and costly shop sale; v48/v49 concern named command dispatch, inventory/menu/history/version/naming. This case reaches a different handler or state/action branch. Shorter setup probes of this same case remain excluded.
